exit_rules_confirmed_is_actionable.name: exit_rules_confirmed_is_actionable
exit_rules_confirmed_is_actionable.value: "exit_rules"."status" <> 'CONFIRMED' OR "exit_rules"."rule_type" IS NOT NULL OR "exit_rules"."thesis_break_triggers" IS NOT NULL

instruments_option_fields.name: instruments_option_fields
instruments_option_fields.value:
CASE WHEN "instruments"."instrument_type" = 'option'
        THEN "instruments"."underlying_symbol" IS NOT NULL AND "instruments"."option_right" IS NOT NULL
          AND "instruments"."strike" IS NOT NULL AND "instruments"."expiry" IS NOT NULL
        ELSE "instruments"."underlying_symbol" IS NULL AND "instruments"."option_right" IS NULL
          AND "instruments"."strike" IS NULL AND "instruments"."expiry" IS NULL
        END
